Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 10417 - 1983 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

EQUAL CROSS COUPLING ASSEMBLY FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and other requirements for equal cross coupling assembly used in 
oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1.

IS : 10417 - 1983 

3. Assembly Details — An equal cross coupling assembly consists of ferrule, as per IS : 8802-1978 
' Ferrules for oil-hydraulic couplings, ' coupling nuts as per IS 8803-1978 ' Coupling nuts for oil-hydraulic 
couplings' and an equal cross body as per IS : 9746 ( Part I )-1983 ' Equal cross body for oil-hydraulic 
couplings Part I Made from forging ' or IS 9746 ( Part II j-1981 ' Equal cross body for oil-hydraulic 
couplings Part II Made from barstock * 

4. General Requirements — For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to 
IS 8805 ( Part I )-1978 ' General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems 
Part I General \ 

6. Designation — An equal cross coupling of light series Lfor 6 mm outside diameter and conforming 
to this standard shall be designated as 

Cross Coupling L 6 IS 10417 
6. ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
